text: Review `e0a71a82-a25c-4486-924d-758bcc358ab0` (“Time to leave Spotify”) and two similar ones (`622b7b62…` “I want stop this aap.”, `f72679f8…` romanized Hindi: already uninstalled, YouTube is fine) are pure departure statements with no product feature. On both allowed attempts the enricher returned a subtopic key outside the allowed list, so code rejected the item (`label_not_allowed`). After the single permitted retry the texts were **quarantined** with reason `label_not_allowed`, attempts=2 (`grading/records.jsonl`, `state` quarantine table), and they count as incomplete. Root cause: the taxonomy has no obvious key for a cancellation with no feature. `other/general_criticism` is the intended key, but the prompt's examples always pair cancellation with a feature. Fix for a v4 prompt (not applied, because enrich_v3 is frozen for cache and resume validity): add a worked example such as “Time to leave Spotify => general_criticism, cancellation, -0.7, 2”. Separately, review `292ce26a…` (a political rant about content removal, golden #1) shows an ambiguous case handled as designed. It was labeled `other/unclear`, severity 1, `needs_review=true`. The golden label is catalog/complaint with accepted alternates other/unclear, so it counts as correct under accepted labels. The model's quote failed exact-substring validation twice, so code used the deterministic first sentence and flagged it (`review_reason: model_flagged;quote_fallback_first_sentence`).
